text:
Main samajh sakta hoon ki yeh bohot pareshan karne wali baat hai. System me status abhi bhi update nahi hua hoga, lekin aapki yeh baat bilkul serious hai. 

Kyunki item tootne ki aawaz aa rahi thi aur box damaged tha, main is order ke liye refund initiate kar raha hoon. 

Aapke order `ORD-22006` ka poora amount **₹2199** refund karne ke liye request daal raha hoon. Kya main yeh refund process kar doon?
